topPRs.title: eth/067-070: bump Security Council nonce pins after signer rotation
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Why

The Security Council executed a signer rotation (`swapOwner`) at nonce 64 on 2026-09-08 ([tx](https://etherscan.io/tx/0xef9051e4692d97a04ec70ba033915a8e304989ee504da1e5b14674c6f9e3770a)), moving its live nonce to **65**. The four pending mainnet tasks pinned SC nonces 64/65/66/67, so all of them were one behind and any SC signature collected against the old pins would be rejected on-chain.

## What changed

| Task | SC pin (old → new) | SC message hash (new) |
|---|---|---|
| eth/067-mmzd-l1-ownership-transfers | 64 → 65 | `0xca2592b0b722f9b621a72604e6b511bfd9c3cebfa97f55e11ee2f13bd45e9de6` |
| eth/068-mmzd-l2pao-transfer | 65 → 66 | `0xdf6152719fe481c57a6f2c189e74c73db6108f13095363d470556be9f096dafe` |
| eth/069-unichain-l1-ownership-transfers | 66 → 67 | `0x5e7b347c7dc25fdfb5efbb3ad0745dccf142808f1462123f7e31eea4d3065211` |
| eth/070-unichain-l2pao-transfer | 67 → 68 | `0x09c761ddf57ec5d4e262720b50f5de39e3d30dd8847be544b1d76e5f8a0400c7` |

**Unchanged:** L1PAO (40), Foundation Upgrade Safe (66), Unichain 3-of-3 (10) and Chain Governor (19) live nonces still match their pins, so their hashes and any signatures already collected on those paths remain valid.
